title: Expose the package version as runstat.version.VERSION
goal: Tools that report which runstat produced a file need the version in one importable place instead of reading pyproject.toml at run time.
acceptance: src/runstat/version.py defines VERSION as the string "0.1.0"
no absolute paths in any committed file
verify: grep -q 'VERSION = "0.1.0"' src/runstat/version.py && python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from runstat.version import VERSION; assert VERSION == '0.1.0'"
